summary: Greenland Mines Ltd filed an 8-K on September 28, 2026 reporting a September 28 securities purchase agreement with certain institutional investors for a direct registered offering of 1,320,000 common shares. Net proceeds are expected to be approximately $17.2 million after estimated offering expenses, implying a gross price near $13 per share, though no per-share price is stated. Shares are offered under an effective Form S-3 shelf (File No. 333-288533); closing is expected on or about September 29, 2026, subject to customary conditions. Proceeds fund Greenland mining operations and working capital. This is a routine shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch for dilution and pricing terms in the prospectus supplement.
